pages.text: One corner of the barn caught the sunshine. But old things filled it.
Lulu rolled up both sleeves. "I will clear this and make a place to play."
Uncle Beppo followed inside. "Let us see. Nothing here to throw away."
Lulu took out an old basket. He gathered it back. "In our day, we carried bread in this."
Lulu took out a round sieve with holes. He gathered that back too. "We sifted flour with this."
Everything taken out came back in. No space had been made.
Old things filled Uncle Beppo's arms. He could not see ahead and staggered.
Lulu pointed to the opposite corner. "Let us gather all the old things there!"
Together, they moved the things. The sunny corner was clear.
Lulu played in the new space. Across the barn, Uncle Beppo looked at his old things. Now both had a place.
